evidence.title: POST Events
evidence.findings: Adds Event; EventDate required; EventId not required. JSON/XML accepted; text/plain Accept yields ID string, otherwise created GranicusEvent object.
evidence.limits: Endpoint schema does not prove write-token permissions or concurrency enforcement.

evidence.title: PUT Event
evidence.findings: Updates Event; EventId in path and body required; EventDate required.

evidence.title: POST EventItems
evidence.findings: Adds Event Item under EventId; EventItemId not required; exact prefixed fields documented.

evidence.title: PUT EventItem
evidence.findings: Updates parent-scoped EventItemId; body ID not required per endpoint description.

evidence.title: POST MatterAttachment
evidence.findings: MatterAttachmentName required; MatterAttachmentBinary byte collection serializes base64 JSON; MatterAttachmentSort auto-generated, do not set.

evidence.title: PUT MatterAttachment
evidence.findings: Updates attachment; MatterAttachmentSort cannot be changed.

evidence.title: Legistar examples and tokens
evidence.findings: 1000 response cap; $top/$skip; EventDate ge lower/lt upper; stable ID order and greater-than highest-ID paging recommended for busy sites. Some tenants require token query parameter. GET limited to public InSite-visible records.
evidence.limits: Keep token out of citations/logs. HTTP documented but engine requires HTTPS. Token scope for write not established.

evidence.title: Olympia public Events
evidence.findings: Public endpoint returned event content including durable MeetingDetail URL.
evidence.limits: FetchUrl rendered fields as flattened text, not validated raw JSON; no engine parse/discovery test.

evidence.title: Legistar Web API published route index reviewed for meeting media
evidence.observed: Official Web API route index inspected on 2026-11-11.
findings: Index lists Event create/update fields EventMedia and EventVideoPath as strings and linked MatterAttachment GET/POST/PUT/file routes.
The published route index contains Events, EventItems, MatterAttachments, Matters and related entity sections but no dedicated media or recording endpoint section.
evidence.limits: Absence from this route index does not prove a meeting-media API is unsupported. EventMedia/EventVideoPath semantics, accepted URLs, any non-indexed media endpoint, and replacement receipts remain unresolved; use vendor support/test tenant documentation if offered.

evidence.title: East Brunswick selected-window server-side item pager traversal
evidence.observed: Read-only GET plus 12 current-state pager POSTs; no credentials, writes or attachment downloads.
findings: Form date values were 2026-08-11 through 2027-02-11. The initial item grid declared 180 rows across 12 pages at 15 rows/page; refreshed ASP.NET hidden/control state and session cookies were carried on each POST. The current meeting grid showed 11 rows. Form controls include `ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder1$SearchAgendasMeetings$ddlDateRange`, `radCalendarFrom`, `radCalendarTo`, `ctl00` (meeting type), `ctl01` (category), `ctl02` (text), and `radGridItems$ctl00$ctl03$ctl01$PageSizeComboBox`; carry the returned `__VIEWSTATE`, Telerik client state and current ASP.NET cookies without logging/saving cookie values.

All 12 item pages were captured in outputs/provider-route-probes-2026-11-11/novus-eastbrunswick-page-01-of-12.body through novus-eastbrunswick-page-12-of-12.body. The page traversal manifest records each body byte length and SHA-256 at outputs/provider-route-probes-2026-11-11/novus-eastbrunswick-page-traversal-2026-11-11.json (SHA-256 ffb5d79cf0b4ffee66535849f4120930c8f2c592ad17bd3ec0c3ad19ff1dde6b).

Item rows use `table[id*='radGridItems_ctl00'] tr.rgRow, table[id*='radGridItems_ctl00'] tr.rgAltRow`; meeting rows use `table[id*='radGridMeetings_ctl00'] tr.rgRow, table[id*='radGridMeetings_ctl00'] tr.rgAltRow`. Pager continuation is the current response's Next Page `__doPostBack` target; submit refreshed hidden state, Telerik state and cookies on each POST. The first target and later targets differ, so do not hardcode them.

Re-parsing the captured rows found 75 rows with literal Coversheet.aspx?ItemID=...&MeetingID=... onclick links (75 unique pairs) and 105 rows without such links. Only linked values are provider IDs; no IDs were inferred for unlinked rows.

vendor_file_export.details: The source engine prepares canonical Agenda, Agenda Packet, Minutes, Notice and Other PDFs plus a Media MP4. The official article gives literal successful filename examples for only Agenda, Agenda Packet and Minutes; its embedded Filename Tester v3.5.9 classifies Notice/Notices as Notice, Packet/Agenda Packet as Agenda Packet, Media .mp4 as Video, and Other as Other. The implementation checks full-filename classifier compatibility, PDF structure, bounded MP4 box framing, exact local bytes and hashes, file caps and projection losses. It rejects the ambiguous aliases Packet, Notices and Audio/Video. Its ZIP is a local wrapper, not a vendor ZIP importer or FTP transfer.
remaining_verification: The linked tester is preparation evidence only; backend acceptance of canonical Notice, Other and Media filenames remains unverified because no consultant or vendor import was performed.

Resolve the conflicting FTP host and obtain project-lead credentials before any transfer; none was attempted or authorized in this research.

evidence.title: Agenda and Meeting Management Essential Public API
evidence.observed: Official public API page read on 2026-11-11; page updated 2025-11-14 and announces Essential end-of-life 2027-06-30.
findings: Support-issued client id and secret are required to request a bearer token via client_credentials at https://auth.devmunicode.com/connect/token; published API sample host is https://meetingsgov.devmunicode.com.

POST /PublicApi/meeting/collection/{offset:int} accepts JSON MeetingListFilters: Words; CreatedMeetingFromDate and CreatedMeetingToDate {Day,Month,Year}; ArchivedState enum None=-1, All=0, UnArchived=1, Archived=2; MeetingTypeIds string array.
GET /PublicApi/meeting/{id}, GET /PublicApi/item/{itemId}, and GET /PublicApi/meeting/multimedia/{meetingId:guid} are documented. Multimedia response sample parses a meetingStructure object.

POST /PublicApi/meeting/multimedia/update/{meetingId:guid} accepts MeetingStructure {Id,MeetingId,AudioVideoDetails:{AudioVideoProviderType,AudioVideoUrl},PublishState,MultimediaItems:[{EntityId,EntityName,EntityTypeName,TimeStamp,MultimediaDisplayOptions,CustomDisplay,IncludeNumbering,UseDefaultMultimediaSettings,MultimediaBaseUrl}]}.
The published API page documents read methods for meetings/items and update for multimedia timestamping; it does not show meeting/item create/update or document upload methods.
evidence.limits: Published examples use a dev test base only; no production tenant host inferred. Meeting/item response bodies are not specified beyond generic HttpResponseMessage. Multimedia example uses {meetingStructure:...}; collection has offset path but page size, end condition, total/result paging metadata are unspecified. No support token or test tenant supplied; no auth endpoint called and no live API request made.

evidence.title: Guarded WebLink session live access probes
evidence.observed: Bounded guarded browser/network probes; all owned sessions closed.
findings: The optional GuardedWebLinkSession routes browser network through PublicTransport and retains the offline-browser safeguards documented in docs/WEBLINK-SESSION.md.

Boulder returned weblink_guarded_request_failed before an HTTP status because the guarded transport refused the cross-origin redirect boundary; Louisville returned HTTP 403 weblink_access_required. These are access/path blockers, not unsupported-operation evidence.
evidence.limits: Neither tenant produced a catalog. No challenge bypass, alternate route, credentials, document download, or mutation was attempted. Receipt records live_write=not_run and catalog_acceptance=incomplete.

evidence.title: Import Media from URL
evidence.observed: Official full documentation fetched and read
evidence.findings:
This endpoint imports a media file from a given URL. The import is processed
asynchronously and will return a background_job_status object rather than the
typical Media response object. You can poll the background job status endpoint
to check on the progress of the import.

If no folder_id is provided, a new folder called "Untitled Folder" will be
created and the imported media will be placed there.

The URL must be publicly accessible — Wistia's servers need to be able to fetch the file directly.

Note: imports from certain domains (e.g. vimeo.com, wistia.com) are not permitted.

made with such a token are authorized using the permissions of the
contact assigned to the token.
